reported_by: anomalica/workbench - the corrupt names were visible on its Topics tab and it had no way to fix them
fault: An acronym expanded while sitting inside ANOTHER acronym's gloss, nesting one expansion inside the other. Two shapes, and the existing guards saw neither - they ask whether THIS acronym is already expanded, while here a DIFFERENT acronym's expansion is damaged and the one being substituted is genuinely unexpanded.

examples.within the gloss itself: 'Mutual UFO Network (MUFON)' -> 'Mutual Unidentified Flying Object (UFO) Network (MUFON)' - MUFON's own expansion corrupted from the inside
examples.self-repeat: 'weapons of mass destruction (Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD))'

why_the_squadron_guard_missed_it: It tests for an exact substring of OUR wording. The source wrote 'Antisubmarine' where the table says 'Anti-Submarine' - the variant-wording miss the code's own comment predicted, written for the programme acronyms and never extended to the squadron prefixes.
code_fix: 30ffb76 - substitution skips any match inside a parenthetical or inside another acronym's full expansion. Verified over every digest: names the importer would now nest = 0.

repair.note: Where the corrected name already existed the corrupt duplicate was MERGED into it rather than renamed - extrasensory perception, PTSD, EEG and VFA-11 each had both forms live.
repair.left_alone_why: legitimate titles whose descriptive parenthetical contains an acronym, e.g. 'Exploring Space with a Camera (National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) SP-168)' and '"Blinded by the Light" (Mutual UFO Network (MUFON) Journal)'. Nesting is correct there.

not_done.why: 57 page-proposed nodes start lowercase - 'alien abduction', 'telepathy', 'levitation'. They read as typos on the site. NOT repaired: capitalisation is a naming-convention decision, not a corruption, and 'topic' names may be deliberately lowercase as common nouns. Needs a convention before a pass.
